description_en: Configures the full image matching switch for a data synchronization instance
description_zh: 配置同步全镜像匹配开关
name: ConfigureSynchronizationJobReplicatorCompare

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
You need to specify this parameter only if the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
指定同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，才需要传入本参数
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable full image matching. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
全镜像开关，取值：
true：打开。
false：关闭
parameters.name: synchronization_replicator_compare_enable

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
